name: Browse a featured title and open its details
description: Verifies that the featured series opens a useful detail view from the home screen.
steps: Select More Info for Glass Harbor
Review the title details and select Play
expected: The Glass Harbor detail dialog shows its synopsis and a Play action.

name: Search by title or genre
description: Verifies searching filters the catalog and shows a helpful empty state.
steps: Replace the query with an unmatched phrase
expected: Mystery titles appear first, then the no titles found message appears for the unmatched phrase.

name: Save and remove a title from My List on mobile
description: Verifies a title can be saved, found in My List, and removed from a narrow screen.
steps: Add the title to My List
expected: The saved title appears in My List and disappears after removal.
